sections.heading: What is trending: “aviação”
paragraphs: “aviação” appeared on Google Trends' Trending Now list for PT (snapshot taken 2026-10-21T07:39:19+00:00 UTC). Google reports at least 200 searches for this term — that figure is a lower bound published in the official Trends feed, not an exact count.

sections.heading: What's behind the spike — the coverage
paragraphs: The Trends feed associates this search spike with 3 news stories from AEROIN, Euronews.com, ND Mais. The headlines, exactly as published:
list: “IA e transformação digital estão a mudar a aviação, mas a segurança continua a ser inegociável” — Euronews.com
“De chatbots à respostas em tempo real, empresa de tecnologia aborda a evolução da inteligência artificial na aviação” — AEROIN
“Aviação doméstica bate recorde no Brasil com 76,8 milhões de passageiros transportados entre janeiro e setembro” — ND Mais

sections.heading: Timeline
paragraphs: The trend entry was published to the Google Trends feed at Tue, 20 Oct 2026 23:50:00 -0700. Our snapshot was taken at 2026-10-21T07:39:19+00:00 UTC and this briefing was assembled at 2026-10-21T07:39:54+00:00 UTC.

sections.heading: How to read these numbers
paragraphs: Google Trends reports approximate search volume as a lower bound (for example “20K+”). Actual volume can be significantly higher. Trending status reflects acceleration in searches, not the absolute size of a topic. For the full story behind the spike, read the cited coverage below — this briefing intentionally adds no speculation beyond the sourced facts.
